programmes.evidence: Mechanical Engineering Doctoral outcomes explicitly map doctoral study and original research to three departmental specializations. Manufacturing and Materials Systems Engineering specialization includes production integration, cellular manufacturing, ergonomics, reliability/quality estimation, human performance/safety, quality systems and complex manufacturing system analysis, establishing substantive IE/Operations scope.
limitations: Actual award remains Mechanical Engineering PhD; specialization is not an independent Industrial Engineering degree.
Materials processing/manufacture alone is not the eligibility rationale; production systems, quality and ergonomics mapping is explicit.

branches.conclusion: Full live graduate inventory contains business master’s/MBA programmes without a business doctorate. Current relevant department offers undergraduate majors; these do not establish a PhD.

Engineering full inventory and all listed broad engineering doctoral fields checked via detail/specialization pages. Mechanical PhD explicitly maps to manufacturing specialization with production-system/quality/ergonomics scope; retained as qualifying actual host. Biomedical, Electrical/Computer, Civil and mathematical descriptions do not establish another qualifying Operations route.

sources.note: Entire live unfiltered graduate programme list read. Business programmes MBA/EMBA, Management and other master’s awards; no business PhD listed. Engineering and Computational Mathematical and Statistical Sciences doctorates listed.

Entire engineering summary read: Biomedical, Civil/Construction/Environmental, Electrical/Computer and Mechanical doctoral fields. Summary also labels Health Care Technologies Management MS/PhD, conflicting with linked detail. Systems Engineering card links a graduate certificate. Expand-all control did not reveal extra specialization content in returned visible text.

Computational Mathematical and Statistical Sciences PhD programme detail and expanded Is This Program Right For Me section read. 57 credits, computational/applied mathematics/statistics and scientific/engineering models; no explicit OR doctorate specialization established.

Linked programme detail explicitly titled Master’s in Healthcare Technologies Management, 37-credit joint master’s with Medical College of Wisconsin, currently not admitting. This contradicts summary PhD label; no doctoral route inferred.

Civil/Construction/Environmental master’s and PhD detail read, including expanded Specializations: construction, environmental/water resources, structures/mechanics, transportation/materials. No explicit OR/Ops/IE field established.

Current Supply Chain and Systems Intelligence page read: explicitly department and chair, four connected undergraduate majors Operations & Supply Chain Management, IS, Business Analytics, AI. Confirms earlier unit identity; undergraduate ASCENT projects not PhD provision.

Mechanical doctoral and Manufacturing and Materials Systems Engineering accordions expanded and read. Doctoral outcomes explicitly require one of three departmental specializations and original research; manufacturing specialization explicitly includes cellular manufacturing, production integration, ergonomics, reliability/quality, human performance/safety, complex manufacturing systems and quality systems. This substantive production-system/ergonomics scope supports IE/Operations classification; materials processes alone would not.

Official department home explicitly names Department of Mechanical Engineering, Opus College of Engineering, and Doctor of Philosophy in Mechanical Engineering with manufacturing systems concentration.

Biomedical MS/PhD full specialization inventory read: bioinstrumentation, biomechanics, imaging, cellular/molecular, computational biology/bioinformatics and rehabilitation. No separate Operations specialization established.

Electrical/Computer PhD detail and all nested specialization accordions read. Electrical: signal processing, communications, controls, power/energy, devices/microsystems; Computer: ML/algorithms, embedded/IoT, vision/image processing. No explicit qualifying Operations specialization; methods alone not classified as OR.

limitations: Current live programme inventory scope only; no historical census.
Healthcare summary MS/PhD label still conflicts with master’s-only programme detail and no current admissions. No qualifying Operations doctorate established there; contradiction preserved.
Computational mathematics and electrical controls/ML methods alone not classified as OR.
